Card Q&A.a: If you have a Digimon with [Three Musketeers] in its type in play in your battle area, you can use this Option card even if you don’t have a red Digimon or Tamer in play.
Card Q&A.q: "If you have a Digimon with [Three Musketeers] in its type in play, you may use this Option card without meeting its color requirements.” How does this effect work, exactly?

Card Q&A.a: The effect deletes your opponent’s Digimon with the lowest DP. If multiple Digimon are tied for lowest, all of them are deleted.
Card Q&A.q: What does “all of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest DP” mean, exactly?

Effect: If you have a Digimon with [Three Musketeers] in its type in play, you may use this Option card without meeting its color requirements.
[Main] Delete all of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest DP.
